{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the number of loyal customers and number who converted
n_loyal = len(loyal_df)
n_converted = loyal_df['converted'].sum()

# Compute conversion rate
conversion_rate = n_converted / n_loyal

# Print the values used in evidence
print("Number of loyal customers:", n_loyal)
print("Number of converted loyal customers:", n_converted)
print("Conversion rate:", conversion_rate)"}
